_comment: Voices rendered with F5-TTS instead of Kokoro, cloned from a reference clip. Only N.O.V.A. is cloned; Kaelen stays on Kokoro (Abe, 2026-09-24).
The reference is made by tools/make_voice_ref.py: Kokoro in the character's game voice, steady delivery (no shouting), trimmed, normalised, with its exact transcript.
speed and nfe (sampling steps) apply to every line in that voice.
nova_baked is cut from one of the old F5 Nova clips (assets/audio/cast_en/nova_d4021d1329df8e38.wav); set voices.voice.nova.v1.ref to it to use that instead.
respell: how F5 should say words it gets wrong (the line's text, subtitles and data keep the real spelling).
